newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close down, unimpressed by new cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close down, unimpressed by new cabinet.

text.p: Thai stocks ended lower on Friday as investors shrugged off news of cabinet reshuffle and heavily sold off telecommunication and building material shares, brokers said.
The composite SET index was off 5.44 points to close at 623.25 on 2.4 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index was down 0.56 to 47.
Brokers said the selling in big-cap Siam Cement and TelecomAsia had led the key index fall today.
"Selling pressure was really on big-cap Siam Cement and TelecomAsia. Investors were really unimpressed by the cabinet reshuffle," said one broker at a bank-backed brokerage.
